comments.content: [medium] Logic problem: when formatting a Data object, the template only receives `text=data.get_text()`, so the only usable placeholder is `{text}`. This diverges from the DataFrame path (line 126), where every column is exposed via `**row.to_dict()`. A Data object whose `data` dictionary holds several fields (e.g., `{"name": "John", "age": 30, "text": "..."}`) can't have `{name}` or `{age}` referenced in the template. Switching to `template.format(**data.data)` would expose all Data fields to the template, matching the DataFrame behavior.
[low] Add a regression case for `from .parser import ParserComponent` with a value at the documented limit.
